text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll be racing against Bourbon and
McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A little. And maybe just a tiny bit scared
too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
What if I lose? What if I don't meet
everyone's
expectations? What if I make
everyone upset?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
When I get lost in thoughts like that, I
can feel
myself freezing up.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But if I put my hand on chest...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I get a warm feeling deep in my heart,
and I know
I'll be okay.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...You've got it. See you at the finish
line!
